name: The Ritz-Carlton Naples, Tiburon
positioning: Golf and family resort near Naples, Florida (official name The Ritz-Carlton Naples, Tiburón), with two Greg Norman golf courses, a waterpark and a tennis center
best_for: Golfers who want two Greg Norman-designed courses on site
Families who want a waterpark and a kids program

facts.text: The resort is three miles from the Gulf.
The resort sits among native wetlands and migratory bird preserves.
Tiburón Golf Club has two championship golf courses designed by Greg Norman.
The two 18-hole courses are certified as an Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary and have no conventional rough.
The Reservoir waterpark has waterslides, a winding river and a children's splash area.
Ria serves regional classics from Mexico, Peru and Argentina, with handmade tacos and signature margaritas.
The suites include the Presidential and Tiburón Suites, with views of the resort grounds or the golf courses.
The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge is for guests staying in Club-level rooms and suites.
The Ritz Kids program explores the resort's place within an Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary.
Tiburón Golf Club's Caddie Concierge program pairs each group with a professional attendant.

highlights.text: The resort has Patrick Mouratoglou's first signature Tennis Center in Florida.
The resort fee includes daily access to the Audubon Corkscrew Swamp Sanctuary for two guests.
The Vault is an adult sports lounge with an HD sports simulator, darts and pool.
Poolside cabanas include a butler, plush lounge seating and lunch service.

considerations.text: Beach access is at the sister property, The Ritz-Carlton, Naples, reached by a complimentary daily shuttle.
Complimentary breakfast is not currently served.
